name: subscription_id
description: Unique identifier for this detected recurring service

name: service_name
description: Normalized service name (e.g. Netflix, GitHub, AWS, Spotify)

name: sender_email
description: Sender email domain or address associated with billing

name: currency
description: Billing currency code (USD, EUR, SGD, GBP, etc.)

name: frequency
description: Billing cadence (monthly, annual, quarterly, weekly, variable)

name: last_billed_date
description: Date of the most recent receipt or billing notice

name: unsubscribe_url
description: Direct link or portal to cancel or manage the subscription

name: is_active
description: Flag indicating if the subscription is actively recurring

name: detected_at
description: Timestamp when the subscription was cataloged
